Groups of 3+ are ALL protected and listed in larger_groups, but only those whose members are sibling discs are labelled MULTI_DISC_SET — REPEATED_COPIES means three or more copies of the SAME album, not a box set. Their folders stay protected in every other pair (PROTECTED_GROUP_MEMBER). Resolved pairs and nested quarantine artifacts are excluded.
